description.zh:
业务类型，多个用竖线（|）分隔。取值：
- **live**：直播流媒体。
- **download**：大文件下载。
- **vod**：视视频点播。
- **all**：全部业务类型。
description.en:
Business type. Separate multiple business types with a vertical bar (|). Valid values:
- **live**: live streaming media.
- **download**: large file download.
- **vod**: video on demand.
- **all**: all business types.

description.zh:
待查询的域名列表。支持批量域名查询，多个域名用竖线（|）分隔。

不传该参数将查询全部。
description.en:
List of domain names to query. Supports batch domain name queries. Separate multiple domain names with a vertical bar (|).

If this parameter is not specified, all domain names are queried.

description.zh:
运营商代码，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。

查询请参见[通用字段参考](~~151572~~)。
description.en:
ISP code. Separate multiple ISP codes with a vertical bar (|). Set to all for all ISPs.

For more information, see [Common field reference](~~151572~~).

description.zh:
终端代码，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。

查询请参见[通用字段参考](~~151572~~)。
description.en:
Platform type code. Separate multiple platform type codes with a vertical bar (|). Set to all for all platform types.

For more information, see [Common field reference](~~151572~~).

description.zh:
地域代码，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。

查询请参见[通用字段参考](~~151572~~)。
description.en:
Region code. Separate multiple region codes with a vertical bar (|). Set to all for all regions.

For more information, see [Common field reference](~~151572~~).

title.zh: 获取加速域名的网络带宽监控数据
title.en: Get network bandwidth monitoring data of accelerated domain names

descriptions.zh:
> - 单位：bit/second。

- 不指定StartTime和EndTime时，默认读取过去24小时的数据；指定StartTime和EndTime时，按指定的起止时间查询。
descriptions.en:
> - Unit: bit/second.

- If StartTime and EndTime are not specified, data from the last 24 hours is read by default. If StartTime and EndTime are specified, data is queried based on the specified start and end times.
